messages.content: Make one narrow chapter-boundary decision. Return valid JSON only.

A chapter is a large H3 refresh unit.

STORY:
A researcher begins a normal shift. An alarm interrupts. The researcher secures samples and performs a long repeated diagnostic process occupying most of the story. One final diagnostic later resolves the incident.

LEFT:
Normal shift and alarm.

RIGHT:
Secure samples and repeated diagnostic process.

Choose one decision from this allowed set: MERGE, KEEP.
Return a JSON object with "decision" and "reason".

message.content: {"decision":"MERGE","reason":"The normal shift and alarm segment is too short to stand alone as a chapter, while the repeated diagnostics occupy most of the story. Merging them into one large H3 refresh unit provides a smoother narrative flow and ensures each chapter meets the size requirement."}
